Create one seamless tileable warm earth-grey gothic dungeon flagstone texture. Orthographic view STRAIGHT DOWN perpendicular to a completely flat stone surface; the whole square is covered edge-to-edge with ancient worn stone, no perspective, no scene or surrounding border. About 7 to 9 medium irregular rectangular flagstones across the image, staggered artisan masonry, believable slightly uneven joints and corners, hairline cracks, broken beveled edges, fine limestone and basalt grain, subtle damp darker patches and dirty mortar, scattered minute abrasion marks. Carefully detailed original medieval gothic dungeon craftsmanship with no central medallion or focal object. Low-saturation grey-brown, warm taupe and muted charcoal, moderate albedo values so the 3D scene lighting can control darkness; not a near-black image. Uniform flat diffuse ambient illumination: NO baked directional shadows, no highlights, no reflected lights, no ambient-occlusion vignette, no bright wet reflections, no color gradients across the whole image. Dampness represented only by slightly darker stone color. Critical: fully seamless periodic texture, edges match left to right and top to bottom so repeating copies form continuous masonry without visible seams; stones and cracks cut by one edge must continue exactly from the opposite edge. No characters, creatures, bones, blood, loose objects, plants, fire, candles, torchlight, labels, text, logos, watermarks or UI. One material sample only, no collage and no multi-panel layout.

Create one seamless tileable ancient rough stone masonry texture in the same warm low-saturation earth-grey family as an aged gothic dungeon floor. Orthographic view STRAIGHT ON perpendicular to a flat wall surface; entire square filled edge-to-edge with stone blocks and mortar, no perspective and no visible wall top or side. About 5 to 6 courses of broad irregularly dressed rectangular blocks, staggered historical masonry, rough chisel marks and coarse grain, subtle weathered gothic stone-carving fragments and worn beveled borders carved directly into occasional blocks, thin fissures and eroded grout, darker damp patches close to mortar. Restrained, physically convincing medieval cathedral crypt wall material; not a decorative illustration or a carved central plaque. Grey-brown stone, muted warm taupe, dusty charcoal, subtle mineral variation. Moderate albedo so runtime lighting controls the darkness. Uniform flat diffuse ambient lighting only: NO baked directional shadow, no shiny highlights, no torch coloration, no ambient-occlusion vignette, no global gradient or glowing cracks. Critical: fully seamless periodic texture, matching left and right edges AND top and bottom edges, so repeating copies form continuous wall courses without visible seams. Keep all carving low-contrast and evenly distributed, no focal emblem. No characters, heads, skulls, bones, blood, plants, weapons, doors, windows, fire, candles, text, letters, logos, watermarks or UI. One material sample only, no collage and no multi-panel layout.
